'''Imperial Economics Advisor''' was a civilian position within the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Imperial Civil Service|Civil Service]]. [[Adana Vermor]], who worked in the [[Imperial Office of Logistics]] as an [[Advisor/Legends|advisor]] to the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]], held the position.<ref name="ES">{{WEGCite|story=The Event of the Season|book=Tapani Sector Instant Adventures}}</ref>
